CustomField.description: Compounded COLA price for the final year of a multi-year deal. Derives the annual COLA rate from COLACalculatedPrice__c / Pre_COLA_Price__c and compounds across PricingTermCount years. For single-year deals, equals COLACalculatedPrice__c.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( PricingTermCount > 1, COLACalculatedPrice__c > 0, COLA_Outyear_Uplift_Percent__c > 0 ), ROUND( COLACalculatedPrice__c * EXP( LN(1 + COLA_Outyear_Uplift_Percent__c / 100) * (PricingTermCount - 1) ), 2 ), IF( AND( PricingTermCount > 1, COLA_Uplift_Percent__c > 0, Pre_COLA_Price__c > 0 ), ROUND( Pre_COLA_Price__c * EXP(LN(1 + COLA_Uplift_Percent__c / 100) * PricingTermCount), 2 ), COLACalculatedPrice__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The compounded COLA-adjusted price for the final year of a multi-year subscription. For single-year deals, this equals the COLA Calculated Price.
CustomField.label: Final Year COLA Calculated Price
